summary: An earlier design using coinbase data or memos, reworked by PR #1447; the earlier PR remains open.
coinholder: Changes polling rules; see proposal focus.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: An earlier design using coinbase data or memos, reworked by PR #1447; the earlier PR remains open.

title: Lock-weighted Coinholder Polling
summary: Weight ballots by how long ZEC remains locked; retain participation thresholds in unweighted ZEC.
coinholder: Changes polling rules; see proposal focus.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: Weight ballots by how long ZEC remains locked; retain participation thresholds in unweighted ZEC.

title: Coinholder Grants for Ecosystem Work
summary: Add prospective grants alongside retroactive grants, with payment after verified delivery and USD-denominated compensation.
treasury: Backing remains an open question; existing custody and veto rules retained.
implementation: Add prospective grants alongside retroactive grants, with payment after verified delivery and USD-denominated compensation.

title: Miner Sentiment Polling
summary: Define miner polls using the ZIP 248 coinbase bundle and a published poll definition; do not prescribe the weight of the results.
coinholder: Changes polling rules; see proposal focus.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: Define miner polls using the ZIP 248 coinbase bundle and a published poll definition; do not prescribe the weight of the results.

title: Update to ZIP 1016: Raise the Coinholder Vote Threshold to 1,000,000 ZEC
summary: Raise the ZIP 1016 participation threshold to 1,000,000 ZEC and specify how abstentions count.
coinholder: Changes polling rules; see proposal focus.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: Raise the ZIP 1016 participation threshold to 1,000,000 ZEC and specify how abstentions count.

title: Update to ZIP 1016: Minimum Human Participation and Published Proof-of-Personhood for Coinholder Votes
summary: Require at least 50 verified participants and a published privacy-preserving verification methodology; retain ZEC-weighted ballots.
coinholder: Changes polling rules; see proposal focus.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: Require at least 50 verified participants and a published privacy-preserving verification methodology; retain ZEC-weighted ballots.

title: Update to ZIP 1015: ZCG Committee Members May Not Apply for Grants During Their Term
summary: Bar sitting ZCG members and associated applicants from new grants during their term, with rules for existing commitments.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: Bar sitting ZCG members and associated applicants from new grants during their term, with rules for existing commitments.

title: Update to ZIP 1015: Expand the ZCG Committee to Seven Seats
summary: Expand ZCG to seven seats, introduce a five-member quorum and require four approvals for grants above US$500,000.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: Expand ZCG to seven seats, introduce a five-member quorum and require four approvals for grants above US$500,000.

title: ZCG Treasury Committee, Budget, and Hedging Plan
summary: Separate grant decisions from treasury decisions, with a ten-year budget, treasury plan and hedging strategy.
treasury: Separate committee; publish a ten-year budget and hedging plan.
implementation: Separate grant decisions from treasury decisions, with a ten-year budget, treasury plan and hedging strategy.

title: The Zcash Town Square: Official Discussion and Announcement Cross-Posting
summary: Make the forum the official discussion venue and require funded organizations to cross-post announcements within 24 hours.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: Make the forum the official discussion venue and require funded organizations to cross-post announcements within 24 hours.

title: Coinholder Elections for Zcash Community Grants
summary: Replace ZCAP selection of the ZCG committee with private, ZEC-weighted approval voting; preserve its existing grants mandate.
treasury: See the reviewed draft for program and administration rules.
implementation: Replace ZCAP selection of the ZCG committee with private, ZEC-weighted approval voting; preserve its existing grants mandate.
